messages:
sophia_peopleops: Hey team — need help. My partner passed away on 2026-02-10. I need to remove them from benefits and make sure our 6yo stays covered. Also worried about retro premium proration and whether their pension / 401k survivor stuff changes payroll withholding. I filed the death certificate with probate this morning. Who do I loop in? :(

marcus_benefits: Sorry for your loss, @sophia_peopleops. Death is a QLE — you have 60 days to request changes. We can remove spouse and keep/add children. Effective date can be the date of death for benefits. We'll need a copy of the death certificate + signed QLE form.

john_payroll: Quick payroll note: premiums are typically prorated to the date of the event based on the pay period. If premiums were charged after the date of death, we can issue a retro refund or payroll credit once benefits confirms the effective date. For pension/401k survivor distributions, that’s handled by plan admin — distributions are taxed when paid, payroll withholding doesn't auto-change unless distribution occurs.

lina_med: For medical specifically: if the spouse was the primary subscriber on a separate policy, we'll need to move coverage. For your kid(s) we just need proof of relationship (birth cert already on file?) and the death cert. If you want to enroll the child on a different subscriber record, let us know and we can flip it.

benefits-bot: Hi — here is the QLE submission link: https://benefits.redwood.com/qle — please attach the death certificate and indicate "Death QLE" and desired effective date (2026-02-10). You can also upload docs in Workday under Benefits > Life Events.

sophia_peopleops: Thanks — birth certs are on file for both kids. Two quick things: 1) will I get a payroll refund or check? 2) do I need to update beneficiaries on our 401k immediately or wait?

marcus_benefits: 1) Usually a payroll credit on next cycle; we can issue a manual check if you prefer — payroll will confirm. 2) 401k beneficiary changes are separate — you should contact the plan provider to confirm survivor election. We can provide the paperwork and confirm any company match reversals if applicable.

john_payroll: To action the refund we need: employee ID, pay period(s) affected, and the QLE confirmation number from benefits. Once we have those we calculate overpaid amount and either credit next paycheck or cut a check within ~2 pay cycles. If you need it faster, mark it as urgent and we'll push to the payroll emergency queue. Also note: retro premiums refunded are generally non-taxable adjustments; we'll include notes on the payroll stub.

marcus_benefits: I'll open a case and DM you the case number. Once you upload the death cert + signed QLE I'll approve and send the adjustment to payroll. If you want us to preserve COBRA notices for the spouse record (if applicable for dependents) we'll generate those too.

sophia_peopleops: Appreciate you all. I'll upload the death cert tonight and fill the QLE form. One more ask: can someone confirm whether survivor pension paperwork needs HR legal review? Not sure about company admin vs plan admin.

john_payroll: Plan admin handles distributions; HR legal typically only reviews if company has discretionary survivor policies. If you DM me the plan name I can loop in legal and benefits.

marcus_benefits: Looping @lina_med for enrollment specifics and I'll include legal if needed. Case created: BLT-2026-0891.

sophia_peopleops: Thanks — case noted (BLT-2026-0891). Uploading docs tonight. Really appreciate the quick responses. :heart:
